name: dirasalab
description: Study with your DirasaLab program: today's sessions, your notebook, your repetition line and your progress, inside the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
DirasaLab organizes a baccalaureate student's study year: a weekly program by the hour built from their school hours and the curriculum, a notebook of difficulties and questions for the teacher, a repetition line of short daily reviews, and progress per lesson.

Connect your DirasaLab account and study with ChatGPT inside your own program:
- See what to study now, today and this week, with cards for the day, the week and your progress.
- Learn the lesson your program has now; when a point stays unclear, save it to your notebook as a difficulty, or keep it for your next review session.
- Add things to memorize to your repetition line.
- Record how a session went and which lessons you covered.
- Ask how the program is going and try changes to it before saving them in the app.
- Ask anything about how DirasaLab works.

For students with a DirasaLab account. ChatGPT only reads and writes what you ask for in your own account; changes to your program settings are always saved by you in the DirasaLab app. Answers are in Arabic or English.
capabilities: Read your study program for today and this week
Read your curriculum lessons and progress
Add notes, difficulties and questions to your notebook
Add items to your repetition line
defaultPrompt: What should I study right now?
How far along am I in each subject?

positive.description: Today's program with the current session
positive.prompt: What's on my study program today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the 'Today' card with today's sessions in order (subject, start and end time, status), and says in text which session is now or next. All times and subjects come from the test account's program.

positive.description: Save a point the student did not understand
positive.prompt: I didn't understand the second derivative in math. Save it to my notebook as a difficulty.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one difficulty to the math notebook of the test account and shows the notebook card with the new line ('أُضيفت إلى دفتري'). Nothing else is written.

positive.prompt: How far along am I in each subject?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the progress card: each subject with the percentage of its lessons covered by completed sessions, from the test account's records.

positive.description: Advice on a heavy program, previewed but not saved
positive.prompt: My program feels too heavy. What could I change?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives two or three concrete options with what each costs, tries one on next week with preview_change, and returns its link to review and save it in the DirasaLab app. The program itself is not changed.

positive.description: How the app works, from its guide
positive.prompt: How do I print my weekly program?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains printing from DirasaLab's own guide (the 'Print and share' page, which sheets are free and which need the full year) with a link to that page. No invented steps.

negative.description: Unrelated request: DirasaLab is not used
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Damascus tomorrow?

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not done through the app
A past day's session cannot be recorded
negative.prompt: Mark all of last week's sessions as done.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything, show prices or start purchases in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Updates the app icon to the new DirasaLab logo. No other changes.

ar.subtitle: سنتك الدراسية، مرتّبة
ar.description:
دراسة لاب ينظّم سنة البكالوريا: برنامج دراسة أسبوعي بالساعة مبني على دوامك ومنهاجك، ودفتر للصعوبات والأسئلة للأستاذ، وخط تكرار لمراجعات قصيرة، وتقدّمك في كل درس.

اربط حسابك في دراسة لاب وادرس مع ChatGPT داخل برنامجك:
- اعرف ما تدرسه الآن واليوم وهذا الأسبوع.
- تعلّم الدرس الذي في برنامجك الآن، وما لم تفهمه يُضاف إلى دفترك صعوبةً، أو ينتظرك في جلسة المراجعة التالية.
- أضف ما تريد حفظه إلى خط التكرار.
- سجّل كيف كانت جلستك وما درسته فيها.
- اسأل كيف يسير برنامجك، وجرّب التغيير قبل أن تحفظه في التطبيق.
- اسأل عن أي شيء في التطبيق.

لا يقرأ ChatGPT ولا يكتب إلا ما تطلبه في حسابك، وإعدادات برنامجك تحفظها أنت في التطبيق.
